About Me

I See the Story Behind Your Data

"Data without context is just noise. My job is to turn that noise into a narrative that drives real decisions."

I am Ubaid Ullah, a BI Consultant, Power BI expert, and content writer based in Pakistan. I help businesses and professionals make sense of their data and communicate their expertise to the world.

My work sits at the intersection of business intelligence and storytelling. I build dashboards executives actually use and write content audiences actually read.
